title: 8 cây trồng mới cho Sobi Garden: 8 cây × 4 giai đoạn (mở rộng)
decisions: Expansion proposal 2026-10-16 (owner asked for more variety): 8 crops beside the 5 of garden-01-crops, same rules (crop stands alone on a tiny soil mound, GardenScene draws it on plot_soil, origin at the bottom; same 152x132 shared scale). Mix of pig feed and Vietnamese crops: tomato, pumpkin, sweet potato, cabbage, strawberry, watermelon, sugarcane, sunflower. Root / ground crops show the crop at the base when ripe. Content rows (content/garden/crops.json), seeds, produce icons and manifest rows only after approval.

cells.desc: Tomato sprout: two small fuzzy green seed leaves
Tomato growing: a young bushy tomato plant tied to a short wooden stake, tiny yellow flowers, no fruit yet
Tomato ripe: a leafy tomato plant on a wooden stake with clusters of plump shiny red tomatoes with green star tops
Tomato wilted: the plant slumped on its stake, dry brown leaves, one shrivelled tomato
Pumpkin sprout: two round green seed leaves and one small curly tendril
Pumpkin growing: a low vine with big round leaves and one yellow trumpet flower
Pumpkin ripe: a big round ribbed orange pumpkin sitting on the ground under broad green leaves and a curly vine
Pumpkin wilted: dry brown curled leaves over a small pale soft pumpkin
Sweet Potato sprout: a few small heart-shaped green-purple leaves
Sweet Potato growing: a low spreading vine of heart-shaped leaves with purple stems
Sweet Potato ripe: a lush mound of heart-shaped leaves with two plump purple-red sweet potatoes peeking out of the soil at the base
Sweet Potato wilted: the vine flat and yellow-brown
Cabbage sprout: three small round pale-green leaves
Cabbage growing: a loose open rosette of wavy blue-green leaves
Cabbage ripe: a big round tight pale-green cabbage head wrapped in wavy outer leaves
Cabbage wilted: outer leaves yellowed and floppy, head smaller and dull
Strawberry sprout: a tiny tuft of three-part toothed green leaves
Strawberry growing: a low leafy strawberry plant with small white five-petal flowers
Strawberry ripe: a leafy strawberry plant with several plump glossy red strawberries hanging down, tiny yellow seeds
Strawberry wilted: brown curled leaves and one shrivelled dark berry
Watermelon sprout: two oval green seed leaves
Watermelon growing: a low vine with deeply lobed leaves, a small yellow flower and a tiny striped baby melon
Watermelon ripe: a big oval dark-and-light-green striped watermelon on the ground under lobed leaves and curly tendrils
Watermelon wilted: dry grey-brown vine over a dull small melon
Sugarcane sprout: two narrow green blade leaves from a short cane stub
Sugarcane growing: three short green jointed canes with long arching leaves
Sugarcane ripe: a clump of three tall purple-brown jointed sugarcane stalks with ringed nodes and long green leaves arching from the top
Sugarcane wilted: stalks leaning, leaves dry and straw-coloured
Sunflower sprout: two oval seed leaves on a short stem
Sunflower growing: a sturdy stem with big heart-shaped leaves and a closed green bud
Sunflower ripe: one tall sturdy sunflower with a big round head of golden-yellow petals around a brown seed centre, big leaves
Sunflower wilted: the head hanging down, petals brown and fallen, leaves curled
